subject: Gartner pulse call & Nimbus reference - consent + logistics
messages:
From: Priya Balan <priya.balan@gartner.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 30m 'pulse' call with Nimbus for analyst reference

Hi Marcus,

Quick ask — I'm researching vendor reference patterns for enterprise inference platforms and would love to schedule a 30-minute 'pulse' call with one of your customers in healthcare. Nimbus Health was suggested as a good fit based on their scale and recent deployment.

Scope: 30-minute call, high-level outcomes, what they measured post-launch (latency/cost/user impact), and one short quote we can publish in an analyst note. We typically record for note-taking and ask customers to sign a short consent form (attached).

Could you:
- Confirm Nimbus is open to a short call and quote?
- Share 2-3 dates/times next week (Mar 20–24)?
- Indicate any NDAs/recording restrictions we should be aware of?

Attaching: Gartner_Request_Form.pdf (standard consent + quote clearance form).

Thanks,

Priya Balan
Sr. Research Director, Cloud Infrastructure
Gartner
priya.balan@gartner.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Thomas Reed <thomas.reed@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Priya Balan <priya.balan@gartner.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: 30m 'pulse' call with Nimbus for analyst reference

Thomas — forwarding a Gartner request (Priya) for a very short reference call and a publishable quote. Nimbus was flagged by Priya based on the inference cost/latency results you shared in January — would you be open to a 30-minute window?

Marissa (CS) and Olga (Legal) are looped to keep this light-touch:
- Marissa: can you propose 2x 30-min slots next week and pull a brief usage snapshot (Q1) to share in advance?
- Olga: please flag any legal constraints (recording, quote clearance process).

Thomas — if okay, we can route a short consent form through DocuSign; if you prefer redlines send back the PDF and we'll handle.

Thanks for considering — we appreciate Nimbus being a vocal partner on this.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachment: Gartner_Request_Form.pdf
From: Thomas Reed <thomas.reed@nimbushealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Balan <priya.balan@gartner.com>, Nimbus Legal <legal@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: 30m 'pulse' call with Nimbus for analyst reference

Marcus — happy to help. A few quick constraints from our side:
- We will need the quote to be pre-cleared by our comms/legal team (cc'd).
- Recording is fine for note-taking but we ask for an internal redaction window (we want to review any attribution to people or proprietary metrics before publication).
- We prefer the call to be limited to senior product/ops + one exec (no sales on the call).

Available windows:
- Tue Mar 21, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed Mar 22, 14:00–14:30 PT

I'll attach a short note with our suggested wording and the internal consent email we use for analysts.

Thomas Reed
CTO, Nimbus Health
thomas.reed@nimbushealth.com

Attachment: Nimbus_Consent_Email.eml
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Thomas Reed <thomas.reed@nimbushealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Balan <priya.balan@gartner.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: 30m 'pulse' call with Nimbus for analyst reference — prep + snapshot

Thanks, Thomas — really appreciate it. Confirming Tue Mar 21 at 10:00 PT works for our engineering lead (Ari) and one of your product leads.

To make the 30 minutes high-value, we'll provide a 1-page usage snapshot and a 3-bullet summary of outcomes up front. Draft plan:
- 10:00–10:03: quick intros, framing (Priya)
- 10:03–10:18: Nimbus shares outcomes + operational notes (Ari/Thomas)
- 10:18–10:28: quick clarifying q's from Priya, record for notes only
- 10:28–10:30: next steps + quote clearance process

Attached: usage_snapshot_q1.csv (anonymized token/sla snapshot) — this is sanitized and high-level.

Olga — Thomas flagged pre-clearance/redaction. Can you propose a one-paragraph process we can share on the call and request the comms team sign-off within 48 hours of call? If there are redlines, please send them to Priya but cc me so I can coordinate follow-up.

Thanks all — see you Tuesday.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: usage_snapshot_q1.csv
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Priya Balan <priya.balan@gartner.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Thomas Reed <thomas.reed@nimbushealth.com>, Nimbus Legal <legal@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: 30m 'pulse' call with Nimbus for analyst reference — legal redlines

Hi Priya and everyone,

Thanks for the coordination. Two quick legal notes (high-level):
1) Attribution & Quote Clearance — We require that any direct quote attributed to Nimbus Health or its employees be provided to Nimbus comms for approval prior to publication. Nimbus will provide approval or minimal edits within 48 business hours.
2) Recording & Data — Recording for note-taking is acceptable provided no raw logs or PII are included in the recording. Any metrics provided in follow-up materials must be anonymized or aggregated.

If Gartner needs formal redlines to the attached consent form, please send the PDF back and we'll circulate redlines via DocuSign (I uploaded a template). For speed, DocuSign link: https://docusign.net/envelope/ABC123.

I'll attach our suggested redlines for the consent (redlines.docx) so Priya can see the minimal edits we typically ask for.

Olga Petrov
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com

Attachment: redlines.docx
